# Chart

A picture of numbers: comparison, trend, share or spread.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** A relationship in numbers that is part of the campaign story. Not as decoration, or for a single number.

- **Use it when:** The story is a relationship in a set of numbers, not a single number.
- **Not when:** A table is clearer, the set is too small, or the chart is decoration.

Instead:

- [Table](./table.md): The numbers as rows; often needed beside the chart.

## How Brand expressive uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A number in a table</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> type.body</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A mono font</div></div><div class="cap">Tables are rare; keep the brand voice.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The same numbers are available as a table or text; color is not the only key. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add chart
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
